refinement_artwork.prompt:
Create EXACTLY 8 clean full-body 2D cel-animation IN-BETWEEN DRAWINGS, in a STRICT 4-column by 2-row sprite atlas on transparent background. No text, labels, grids, shadows, ground or background. Each character has generous empty padding and fits from hair tips to boot soles. Same scale in all 8 cells, boot sole baseline at about 94% of each cell height, no crossing into neighboring cells. Landscape canvas, high resolution.

REFERENCE 1 is a labeled chart of 8 START/END pose pairs, c1 through c8, with the fraction of motion to draw. It is reference material, NOT the output layout to copy. The output must contain ONE character drawing per cell, NOT pairs. Read the 8 output cells left to right top row then bottom row, correspond exactly to c1...c8.
REFERENCE 2 is the current base atlas for exact face proportions, opaque costume, cel colors and line weight.

These are true animation in-betweens, preserving character volumes, facial identity, red ice cream cone, collar hardware, jacket cuffs, hair roots, leg lengths and boot shapes. Crisp flat anime ink and two-tone cel shadows, not a glossy illustration or 3D render. Preserve the adult Rebecca character, mint twin tails, forehead goggles, red-orange eyes, red neck marking with mint crosses, oversized black jacket with green circles, opaque dark shorts and gray leggings, green-trimmed chunky boots. Cone stays in her RIGHT hand (screen left when frontal) in every cell. Free LEFT hand acts. Exactly two arms and two legs. Mouths CLOSED, eyes open; talking and blinking are separate patches. Both feet stay grounded in the same moderate stance.

Output poses:
c1. ONE THIRD from pair a1 relaxed arm down toward a5 palm-up low presentation. The free elbow begins lifting, hand still low near thigh/hip, wrist starting to turn upward, shoulders remain near a1. Head frontal with consistent face volume.
c2. TWO THIRDS along the same a1-to-a5 motion. Free hand now near waist, open palm halfway rotated up, elbow lifted outward, cuff trails the wrist slightly. This must be visibly between c1 and a5, not identical to either endpoint.
c3. HALF WAY from a5 low palm to a6 shoulder-level palm. The hand follows a curved upward arc, palm up around chest height, elbow leads; head tilt and coat change only halfway. No sudden arm-length change.
c4. HALF WAY from a7 high gesture overshoot to a8 settled palm-up. Hand at intermediate height and distance, shoulder starts settling, hair and jacket trail the torso return. Preserve continuous arc and silhouette.
c5. HALF WAY from a8 extended palm to b2 bent inward reaction. Free elbow folds inward, open hand halfway toward sternum, wrist turning, brow starting to lower but not full pout. Cone remains stable.
c6. HALF WAY from b2 inward hand to b3 beginning the right-facing head/body turn and lowering hand. Chin and gaze about halfway turned to screen RIGHT, free hand moving down past upper waist, coat foreshortening starts. Preserve face volume and anatomical lengths.
c7. HALF WAY from b5 impatient reaction to b6 open low invitation. Head starts lifting and returning toward viewer, free hand leaves hip and opens at an intermediate position, eyebrows release. Hair tips lag, collar unchanged.
c8. HALF WAY from b7 forward invitation to b8 low open closing hand. Palm is moving DOWN along a clear arc while elbow folds slightly; eyes meet viewer, small confident closed smile. Hair and cuff settle.

Professional Japanese limited-animation drawing control: consistent on-model volumes and clean silhouette, carefully spaced intermediate anatomy, grounded stance, restrained secondary motion. Do NOT add a new outfit, giant cyberarms, weapon, prop, glowing aura or new lighting. Alpha only outside the figure; black clothes and legs fully opaque. Preserve uniform facial scale across the whole atlas.

refinement_artwork.prompt:
Make a precisely limited correction to this 4-column by 2-row transparent Rebecca animation atlas. Keep all 8 figures, the canvas dimensions, cell positions, heads and faces, torso/coat, cone-holding RIGHT hand, ice cream, legs, boots, hair and colors EXACTLY in place. Only adjust the free LEFT forearm/hand and its attached coat sleeve in these 4 cells. All coordinates below are LOCAL to that 384x512 cell; this is an animation-spacing correction, not a new pose redesign.

TOP LEFT (c1): raise the currently hanging free hand modestly. Palm center should be near x=329, y=259 instead of near y=296. Bend its elbow a little, wrist starting to turn outward/upward. This is the first small lift from a relaxed arm; no big gesture yet.
TOP SECOND (c2): lower the current horizontal palm. Its palm center should be around x=338, y=221, rather than y=192. Keep open palm upward and elbow extended moderately. This is BETWEEN c1's low hand and the later low-presentation pose. It must not look like the endpoint.
BOTTOM LEFT (c5): move the free hand outward from the sternum, toward screen-right. Palm center around x=284, y=160 in this cell. Elbow bent, palm halfway rotated inward/up, fingers relaxed. It is halfway between an extended palm at x~330 and a retracted palm at x~233. Do not leave the hand at the fully retracted endpoint near x=226.
BOTTOM THIRD (c7): the open free palm should be lower and slightly closer to the body: palm center near x=303, y=219 in this cell. Make it halfway between a hip-rest reaction and the later low invitation. Preserve head/eyes and the cone exactly.

Do not edit the other 4 figures (top third, top fourth, bottom second, bottom fourth). Do not alter any face, body scale, foot position, head volume, prop, cell alignment, line weight or palette. Clean continuous arm anatomy with consistent lengths, connected jacket cuffs, five readable fingers when visible, opaque black clothing, alpha only outside figures. No text, grids, background, aura, shadow or artifacts. Preserve the exact crisp flat cel animation style.

refinement_artwork.purpose: Facial alternates; only eye and mouth masks used
refinement_artwork.prompt:
Edit this exact 8-cell Rebecca atlas into a registered facial alternate. Keep the EXACT 4-column, 2-row arrangement, canvas dimensions, every figure's pixel position, head size, pose, facing, scale, boots, torso, hair, costume, hands and red ice cream unchanged. ONLY edit each face:
Close both eyes in natural anime blink lines, preserve eyebrows and the expression in that cell.
Open the mouth for a small talking vowel, dark interior and a pale upper tooth highlight, matching the face perspective. Mouths must remain small and consistent between cells, not shouting. Preserve the existing skin colors around each feature.
All 8 faces blink and talk in this ALTERNATE atlas because separate eye/mouth crops will be composited onto the untouched originals. Do not alter any geometry or the surrounding face/jaw shapes, do not rescale heads, do not change eye spacing, do not shift or re-pose any body, arm, foot, hair or prop. Opaque skin, opaque black coat and gray leggings, transparent exterior. No background, labels, shadow, aura, text or checkerboard. Crisp flat cel animation exactly matching the base.
